lines: Having seen the disciple age-seized, oppressed by disease, having made
depart, then he should join this one in the supreme principle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet
